source.publisher_role: Supplementary Table 4: linear regression model predicting the rate in Tnf-mCherry fluorescence intensity increase using Live-seq data

verdict.label: TOP_DISCOVERY_CANDIDATE_NOT_STABLE_UNIQUE_DRIVER
supported: Nfkbia is the top nominal linear-model feature in the original Supplementary Table 4 ranking.
The fitted direction is negative and the reported R2 is approximately 0.598.
Nfkbia is the only feature with linear-model FDR at or below 0.10 in the workbook.
not_supported: No gene, including Nfkbia, reaches bootstrap FDR at or below 0.20.
The workbook does not establish an externally replicated unique predictor.
The workbook does not establish a direct causal effect or biological-unit generalization.
verdict.reason: Feature selection and effect estimation are performed in the same small target sample, biological independence is unresolved, and no direct external temporal replication candidate is currently available.
